findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "public" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: event_find_matches, event_inbox, event_card_links, event_card_save_linkedin, booth_take_invite, event_say_hello, site_create, event_change_detail, event_guest_requests, event_guest_request_handled, ui_card_diag, events_whats_on, events_speakers · Private data: booth_set_away, biz_set_item_availability, event_redeem_code, event_set_intent, event_find_matches, event_inbox, event_card_links, event_card_save_linkedin, booth_connect, booth_enter_raffle, booth_claim_swag, booth_take_invite, event_reply, event_say_hello, event_requests, event_accept, event_wallet_pass, event_pass_reissue, event_pass_revoke, event_pass_notice, event_meetup_announce, event_meetup_rsvp, event_session_move, event_session_rename, event_session_cancel, event_session_add, event_organizer_overview, site_list, site_get, site_edit, site_publish, site_undo_publish, site_create, event_change_detail, event_change_undo, event_send_request, event_guest_requests, event_guest_request_handled, events_speakers · Public sink: event_redeem_code, event_find_matches, event_inbox, event_card_links, event_say_hello, event_requests, events_list, event_wallet_pass, event_pass_notice, event_meetup_announce, event_meetup_rsvp, event_session_move, event_session_rename, event_session_cancel, event_session_add, site_publish, site_undo_publish, event_change_detail, event_send_request, event_guest_requests, events_whats_on, biz_order, biz_storefront · Destructive: booth_claim_swag, site_edit.
